goal: Restore talent-tree dependency links and make the PostgreSQL SimC refresh preserve the live last-known-good talent graph and profile presets whenever extraction, TraitEdge, identity, encoding, coverage or baseline validation is incomplete.
userValue: Talent simulator connectors remain visible after scheduled refreshes, while a damaged or partial upstream candidate cannot silently erase executable talent rules or profile presets.
nonGoals: No frontend talent geometry redesign or new user-visible talent rules
No change to the public observed-only community gear template policy
No weakening of PostgreSQL-only runtime or serializer fail-closed behavior
No trait_data-only or remote-text fallback publication when the full source archive and profile presets are unavailable
No deploy-triggered asynchronous WebSim, stat-weight or community sync
No dependency installation, third-party download or SimC source update
No PR merge before exact-candidate API, data and real WeChat verification

mustChange: SimC extraction must bound Wago TraitEdge bytes, rows and runtime and preserve a precise extraction error
the scheduled PostgreSQL writer must validate a complete candidate before replacing live talents, presets or spell details
the live PostgreSQL baseline must cover global and per-context node, dependency, graph, encoding and profile content identities

same-source or source-unknown incomplete graphs may recover only by monotonic parent-edge additions with identical nodes and non-edge structure; a source-unknown baseline may not relax any structural, identity, retention or profile guard
rejected candidates must preserve live rows and report a bounded blocked lastAttempt
duplicate SimC profile IDs with different content must receive deterministic content-derived identities
mustNotChange: the active public talent read model remains PostgreSQL-owned and read-only
frontend talent selection remains a consumer of backend node and dependency facts
community gear import continues to preserve governed gems, enchants and embellishments
deployment leaves asynchronous sync disabled unless explicitly controlled after read-only validation
existing healthy same-source graph signatures and profile content identities cannot be replaced or reduced
a missing historical source identity cannot authorize a cross-source overwrite, graph rewire, non-edge mutation, retained-edge loss or profile reduction
riskUnknown: exact production source-tar extraction and Wago TraitEdge parity until candidate validation runs on the known host
real WeChat rendering of connectors and imported enhancement slots until the user tests the exact clean candidate worktree
evidenceRequired: red-to-green tests cover empty candidates, missing edges, malformed rankEntries, graph rewires, profile loss and monotonic incomplete-graph recovery
related Python and deployment tests plus the full repository Harness pass
candidate deployment records exact commit, runtime parity, live PostgreSQL backup and rollback path
read-only production extraction validates 5246 talents, 8465 dependencies, 160 contexts, 40 specs, 80 hero trees and 50 profiles before any write
one controlled SimC-only sync preserves graph/profile identities and community gear enhancement behavior
health, API, timer/backflow, service, log and real WeChat smoke pass before merge

ownership.factOwner: server/postgres_cache_sync.py owns candidate acceptance; server/postgres_cache_store.py::simc_talent_graph_baseline owns the live PostgreSQL LKG projection; server/websim_payload.py owns source extraction
consumers: server/news_backend.py PostgreSQL talent read model and health

engineeringHealth.reason: This changes a write-capable scheduled hotspot. The gate remains read-before-write, uses one live PostgreSQL baseline query, performs linear graph validation, rejects before replacement, keeps the global sync lock and records explicit rollback evidence.

acceptanceEvidence: candidate backup, read-only extraction validation, controlled SimC-only sync and production API/data smoke
real WeChat exact-candidate connector and community enhancement import verification

decisionLog.decision: The user selected option A: integrate the talent-link and community-template fixes through an isolated clean candidate, candidate deployment and manual WeChat verification before merge.
A healthy candidate may repair a same-source incomplete graph only when node identities and all non-edge structure match and every prior parent edge is retained.

When the persisted graph source identity is absent because the previous write was incomplete, recovery is allowed only under the same exact-node, exact-non-edge-structure and parent-edge-superset checks. This source-unknown exception exists to repair a damaged LKG and does not allow an arbitrary cross-source replacement.
The full SimC source archive is required for publication because trait-data-only fallback cannot preserve profile presets; blocked extraction keeps the live LKG.
